notes: The opening «أبی» (with «ره» removed) is the compiler's own father, not named in the text: a relation link, identity not decided.

«أخیه» and «أبیه» are bare relations (rule 7). Abu Ja'far is written inside the chain after «عن», so narrator. The pronoun in «سمعته يقول» has no name in the text; Abu Ja'far is the last link as the one whose words are relayed.
